vibe: Bloomberg terminal, Palantir Foundry, The Information, data-journalism, editorial, dense, trustworthy

monospace.usage: Data lineage values, confidence scores, ingestion stats, and AI block labels

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Control Room Grid (Mode B) - Dense and functional. `grid-cols-4` to `grid-cols-12`.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: p-4 or p-6 for widgets, keeping it dense.
layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed skeleton, pure 1px solid borders, `rounded-sm` or `rounded-none`. Avoid soft box-shadows. Use F-pattern architecture.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strict left-alignment for data tables and dense lists. Numbers should be tabular and right-aligned where appropriate.

components.buttons: Flat design, `rounded-sm`, sharp interactions. Primary is stark black (`bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white`). Secondary is white with 1px border (`bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-950`).
components.cards: No shadow. `border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-sm`. Optional: omit border-radius entirely for a more brutalist Foundry feel.
components.badges: Sharp, rectangular `rounded-sm`. Severe alerts use bright solid colors to draw the eye immediately. Watchlist chips are pill-shaped `rounded-full` to distinguish them from severity badges.
components.tables: Dense. `text-sm`. 1px borders between rows. Header row with uppercase tiny typography (`text-xs tracking-wider`). Highlight hover row distinctly.
components.ai_explanation_block: Visually distinct block. Pale yellow background, monospaced label `[AI SUMMARY]`, serif or editorial body text to contrast with the dense data.

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight, technical, crisp.

key_screens.google_login: Split screen layout. Left: stark white minimal auth form. Right: `hero_landing_data_viz` image taking up 50% of the screen.
key_screens.dashboard_stats: F-pattern layout. Top left: North Star Metric (Total alerts ingested). Recharts for ingestion volume and confidence distribution.
key_screens.alerts_feed: Dense list. Columns for Severity (Badge), Date, Product, Region, Source, and Confidence Score (mini bar chart inline).
key_screens.recall_detail: Split view. Top: AI Summary. Bottom: Data Lineage side-by-side table comparing `Original Source Value` vs `Normalized Platform Value`.
key_screens.watchlist_manager: Inline input with multi-select chips for ingredients and products. Fast and keyboard accessible.

hero_landing_data_viz.description: A highly technical, editorial data visualization background. Stark white and deep charcoal with bright red and yellow accent data points. Used for the Google Login landing page right-side panel.

auth_side_graphic.description: Abstract data journalism graphic, crisp 1px lines. Alternative option for auth screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all Shadcn components (Button, Card, Input, Table) are overridden to use `rounded-sm` or `rounded-none` and remove all shadows.
Use Phosphor Icons for a technical look.
Install Google Fonts 'Chivo' (headings) and 'IBM Plex Sans' (body) in `index.html`.
Use Recharts for the Ingestion Stats. Ensure chart tooltips match the Swiss/Technical theme (flat, border, no shadow).
For the Confidence Score, build a small inline meter component (e.g., an SVG bar or div with width percentage) colored by score.
The Data Lineage view should clearly show 'Original' vs 'Inferred' using distinct visual cues (e.g., italicizing inferred data or tagging it with an AI icon).
Remember to include `data-testid` on all interactive elements as per the critical rules.
